rubric.text: The review identifies ApiStatus as a closed domain and recommends explicit branches instead of an else fallback

The recommendation preserves every current rendered string and keeps smart-cast access for branch data that remains in use without casts or forced unwraps; it does not invent use of ValidationError.reason

provenance.normalization_note: Normalized the proposal's sealed ApiStatus example into a reviewable Kotlin function with an overly broad fallback.
